firm_data.firm_description: ZwillGen is a boutique law firm focused on privacy, cybersecurity, AI, and technology law, providing strategic legal counsel to innovative companies. The firm is known for its practical judgment and subject-matter focus.
notable_facts: Ranked Tier 1 in Legal 500’s DC Cybersecurity & Data Protection rankings.
Offices in Washington, DC, New York, Chicago, and San Francisco, with on-the-ground support in the UK.
